goal: Hard-cap each WoW client launched from a MULTIBOX profile marked LOW to 5 percent total CPU while leaving non-LOW clients uncapped.
notes: Updater-only QoL change. LOW is identified by the existing BelowNormal launch marker, then placed in a Windows Job Object with CPU hard-cap rate 500 (5.00%) and switched to Idle priority. The job handle is duplicated into the WoW process so the cap survives updater exit. Non-LOW clients are not selected. Requires exact feature and integrated updater profile builds plus normal Parallel post-integration gate. Gameplay effect remains unverified until the user tests real multibox clients.
